ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution featuring approximately 75-80% high-intensity (white) pixels and 20-25% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white field across both lobes. Low-intensity black clusters mapped at: 1) the central peduncle/notch junction, 2) a thick, continuous irregular band along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, 3) a distinct small ovoid ring located in the medial-lower region of the left lobe, and 4) scattered focal spots on the right lobe expanse.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated pixel angle approximately 42 degrees with a deep bounding-box penetration into the central fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration pattern along the full trailing boundary. Pixel peaks are particularly sharp and jagged on the distal edges of both the left and right lobes, with deeper irregular valleys visible on the outer left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory moving upwards and outwards from the notch, terminating in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark pixel clusters along the trailing edge serrations; small circular high-contrast dots present in the interior of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct diagonal low-intensity linear marks at the far outer margin of the left lobe; one vertical linear disruption on the lower inner quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent closed-loop pigment anomaly (ring scar) on the left lobe; multiple jagged indentations along the trailing edge suggesting historic tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and isolated ovoid loop-shaped pigmentation mark (ring-like) located on the white substrate of the left lobe's inner-medial section.
